newsitem.title: JAPAN: TIFFE euroyen ends flat after paring early losses.
newsitem.headline: TIFFE euroyen ends flat after paring early losses.

text.p: The key December three-month euroyen futures contract ended flat, after paring early losses in late afternoon trade on Tuesday due to release of weak April machinery orders data, traders said.
"The weaker-than-expected machinery orders data led to concerns about the economy's prospects and triggered buy backs of euroyen futures," a trust bank trader said.
The day session turnover of the December was 51,481 lots.
The upside of the December was capped, however, due to a sharp rise in Tokyo share prices, traders said.
In the Tokyo stock market, the key Nikkei 225 average ended at 20,532.55, up 308.73 points or 1.53 percent from Monday's close.
The December has a good chance of making a try for the upside later this week, traders said.

"Technical charts suggest that the December is likely to make a try for the upside later in the week... The downside is likely to be firm at 98.92 and the upside target will probably be 98.99," a trader for a major brokerage house said.
